issues.summary: NoFeeCampaignRelayer.relay() dereferences relayConfiguration[chainId].maxGasLimit without a guard, and routing no longer requires a local noFeeCampaign entry
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: no-fee-campaign.relayer.ts:81-83 reads `this.relayConfiguration[...].maxGasLimit` unguarded, while getRelaysRemaining guards `!chainConfiguration`. The old relay.manager check `noFeeCampaignConfigurationPerChain !== undefined` was removed, so a chain the config service flags NO_FEE_CAMPAIGN without local config now throws a TypeError, which surfaces as a 500.

issues.summary: The DailyLimitRelayer fallback is gone: a null or missing relayerType now returns 403, which is a rollout risk if the config service isn't populated first
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: relay.manager.ts:59 `default: throw new NoRelayerDefinedError()` replaces the old backward-compat fallback. With `.catch(null)` (chain.schema.ts:108), a missing field also becomes null. The PR intends this (it's listed under "Up for discussion"), but relaying on unconfigured chains breaks unless config-service PR #1555 is deployed and populated first.

issues.summary: No integration test checks the 403 response through RelayerNotAvailableExceptionFilter, or RELAY_FEE routing at the controller level
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: relay.controller.integration.spec.ts has no 403/FORBIDDEN or RELAY_FEE cases. relayerTypeForChainId only ever returns NO_FEE_CAMPAIGN/DAILY_LIMIT for the chains under test. The only coverage is the unit switch in relay.manager.spec.ts:65-73, so dropping the @UseFilters entries would go unnoticed.

issues.summary: `.catch(null)` on relayerType silently turns unknown values into null with no log
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: chain.schema.ts:108 `z.enum(RelayerType).nullable().catch(null)` drops the invalid value with no logging, so a misconfigured config-service value looks the same as a deliberate 'no relayer'. This is a real observability gap, but minor.

issues.summary: .env.sample.json still documents the removed RELAY_DAILY_LIMIT_CHAIN_IDS (required: true) and RELAY_FEE_CHAIN_IDS
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: .env.sample.json:1161-1171 still lists both variables, even though they were removed from configuration.schema.ts and configuration.ts. RELAY_SIMULATION_CHAIN_IDS (mentioned in F13) does not exist, but the main claim holds.

issues.summary: Leftover relay env vars in .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: There is no .devcontainer directory in the repo, and grep finds these variables only in .env.sample.json.

issues.summary: Chains domain schema imports RelayerType from the relay module, creating a bidirectional module dependency
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: chain.schema.ts:6 and chain.builder.ts:17 import from @/modules/relay, and relay.domain.module.ts now imports ChainsModule. There is no runtime cycle, but the layering is inverted.

issues.summary: Fees returns 400 while relay returns 403 when a chain lacks the relevant relayer
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: fees.service.ts:24-28 throws BadRequestException, while relay.manager.ts throws ForbiddenException subclasses. These are different endpoints, but the inconsistency is real and minor.

issues.summary: Relay endpoints don't declare @ApiForbiddenResponse for the new 403 outcomes
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: grep finds no ApiForbiddenResponse in relay.controller.ts. GET :safeAddress (line 156) can now return 403 through RelayerNotAvailableExceptionFilter, and the Swagger docs don't mention it.

issues.summary: 403 Forbidden is a questionable status for 'no relayer defined' or 'relayer type not implemented' (server/config gaps)
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: no-relayer-defined.error.ts and relayer-type-not-implemented.error.ts both extend ForbiddenException. Choosing a status code is a design preference, and the PR description explicitly leaves this behaviour up for discussion.

issues.summary: RelayFeeRelayer.getRelaysRemaining forwards an undefined safeTxHash, supposedly a regression from removing the enabledChainIds guard
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: The removed guard at relay-fee.relayer.ts:~125 only short-circuited on chain mismatch. Before the PR, an enabled chain already forwarded an undefined safeTxHash. Routing now guarantees the chain is RELAY_FEE, so behaviour for that case is unchanged.

issues.summary: No test asserts strict-mode behaviour for a chain without relayer config
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: relay.manager.spec.ts:71 `should throw NoRelayerDefinedError when relayerType is null` covers exactly this case at unit level.

issues.summary: Chain caching delays relayer-mode changes, and there's no hook to invalidate the cache
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: CHAIN_UPDATE config events already invalidate the chain cache (event-cache.helper.ts:112,514; hooks.repository.ts:55), so a hook does exist. The cited file src/config/config-api.service.ts is also not the right path.

issues.summary: The `type RelayerType as RelayerTypeValue` alias in relay.manager.ts is unnecessary
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: relay.manager.ts:5-8 aliases the type even though the RelayerType name already works as both value and type, as relay-manager.interface.ts shows. This is purely stylistic.

issues.summary: The `as Chain['relayerType']` cast in chain.builder is redundant
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: chain.builder.ts:52-57: `arrayElement([...Object.values(RelayerType), null])` already infers `RelayerType | null`. The cast is harmless and exists only in a test builder.

issues.summary: RelayerTypeNotImplementedError takes a string rather than RelayerType
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: relayer-type-not-implemented.error.ts:5 `relayerType: string`. Narrowing it to RelayerType would be a minor type-precision improvement.

issues.summary: RelayerType uses the const-object plus `(typeof X)[keyof typeof X]` idiom instead of an enum
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: relayer-type.entity.ts:2-9. The codebase uses both `export enum` (43 files) and `as const` objects (30 files), so this is a style preference.

issues.summary: RelayerNotAvailableExceptionFilter is applied per method rather than on the controller class
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: relay.controller.ts:82 and :156 add it to each route. That is correct today, and the future-endpoint risk is speculative.

issues.summary: The relayerTypeForChainId test helper re-derives the old env-var partition
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: relay.controller.integration.spec.ts:80-88. This is a test-readability preference with no correctness impact.

issues.summary: The networkService.get chain stub is duplicated across tests
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The integration spec repeats mockImplementation blocks, matching the existing style of the file. Extracting a helper is a preference.

issues.summary: The 'Pay with Safe not available for this chain' message is inaccurate
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: fees.service.ts:26-28 keeps the pre-existing message. Whether the wording fits a future Phase 3 is a copy preference.

issues.summary: The fee-service check may not hold for Phase 3's GTF relayer
issues.label: unverifiable
issues.evidence: fees.service.ts:25 checks `relayerType !== RELAY_FEE`. Whether this fits Phase 3 depends on product plans that aren't in the code.
